name: Mortgages & Home Lending
description: Residential mortgage and home-equity origination, servicing, prepayment, and credit performance.

metrics.name: origination_volume
metrics.description: Funded loan amount in the period

metrics.name: servicing_upb
metrics.description: Unpaid principal balance serviced at a point in time

metrics.name: ltv
metrics.description: Loan amount divided by property value

metrics.name: dti
metrics.description: Monthly debt payments divided by gross monthly income

metrics.name: serious_delinquency_rate
metrics.description: Share of loans 90+ days past due or in foreclosure

metrics.name: pull_through_rate
metrics.description: Funded loans divided by locked applications

conventions.rule: CPR = 1 - (1 - SMM)^12; state whether a speed is CPR or monthly SMM.
State whether LTV uses origination or current (marked) property value, and whether it is combined (CLTV).
Delinquency can be measured by loan count or by balance; state which.

insight_rules.reason: Prepayment speeds are rates; attribute via prepaid principal instead.

caveats.text: Origination and refinance volumes are driven by the rate environment; pair with the mortgage rate series before attributing change to the business.

chart_conventions.rule: Plot prepayment speeds as lines by coupon or vintage; do not stack them.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
